subject: Q3 Launch: Owners commitment roll-call & kickoff
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@averylabs.com>
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Launch: Owners commitment roll-call & kickoff

Team —

We’re kicking off the Q3 launch planning cycle. The ask for this thread: each named owner please confirm your OKR commitment and any hard dependencies by end of day Tuesday (2027-06-01). I attached the working draft of the OKR spreadsheet and an owner commitment form to make responses actionable.

High level:
- Goal: ship Q3 product launch with 99th-pct latency < 150ms for main inference flow, 20% improvement in cost-per-token via batching/quantization, and a measurable uplift in PLG conversion on the new routing policy.
- Owners: product infra (Karthik), product launch/PM (Marissa), finance/forecast (Aditya), enterprise GTM/CS alignment (Ben), exec sponsor (Vivek).

Please confirm:
1) You accept owner responsibility for your named objective(s)
2) List any blockers or escalations we should raise to execs this week
3) Confirm whether the attached metrics sheet accurately reflects your target numbers (or note changes inline)

Meeting: I’ll schedule a 30m owners roll-call for Wednesday 10:00-10:30 PT to close open items — please mark availability.

Thanks — this is timeboxed: quick confirmations keep the board packet from slipping.

—Stephanie Nguyen
Director, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_OKR_draft_v2.xlsx, Owner_commitment_form.docx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 Launch: Owners commitment roll-call & kickoff

Thanks, Stephanie — endorsing.

Quick asks from me:
- Final sign-off deadline to execs is EOD Friday (2027-06-03). Can owners commit to final numbers by then?
- Ben: please validate that the CS QBR ask (customer-facing readiness) is aligned with our GTM timeline; any customer escalations that could affect launch scope should be flagged now.

If we have unresolved infra risk by Wednesday meeting, I want the canary/fallback plan documented (which model variants we fall back to and expected latency/cost deltas).

Vivek
VP, Product & Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 Launch: Owners commitment roll-call & kickoff

Stephanie — accepting ownership for the infra objective. Two notes:
1) Dependency: we need an extra week of validation on the new batching kernel on dedicated GPUs (risk window: 2027-06-07 to 2027-06-14). If validation slips, we should plan to ship with the current kernel and enable the new kernel as a behind-a-flag rollout.
2) Metric suggestion: instead of a single 20% cost-per-token target across the whole workload, propose splitting into infra-sensitive (real-time chat) vs bulk-embed batches so owners can tune quantization/batching independently. I updated cells in the attached sheet (tab: infra-proposal).

If acceptable, I’ll add the fallback kernel plan to the roll-call agenda.

—Karthik
Head of Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps: 

1) Confirmed owners: Karthik (infra), Marissa (product/launch), Aditya (finance), Ben (CS/GTM), Vivek (exec sponsor).
2) Action items before EOD Friday (2027-06-03):
   - All owners: tick confirm on Owner_commitment_form.docx and upload to the drive link (I’ll collect them).
   - Marissa/Karthik: one-pager for Aditya with revenue/cost/headcount assumptions (due EOD Wed).
   - Karthik: add a short fallback kernel plan to the roll-call agenda.
   - Ben: top-5 enterprise customers and any launch-window constraints.
3) Owners roll-call: Wed 2027-06-02 10:00-10:30 PT (calendar invite sent). Attendance required if you still have open blockers.

We have 3/5 confirmations so far — let’s close the rest tomorrow. I’ll produce the final exec packet Friday afternoon for Vivek’s sign-off.

—Stephanie Nguyen
Director, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference
